stops.note: the Noongar name for the small wallaby of south-western Australia, which survives mainly on Rottnest Island, in Noongar Wadjemup
adopted from Noongar; long before, in 1696, Dutch captain Willem de Vlamingh took the animals for giant rats and named the island Rottnest, 'rats' nest'

current_meaning: a small wallaby found mainly on Rottnest Island, Western Australia
